title: Accession or city office?
hook: A ruler succeeds. What does that tell us about city offices?

knows: Selected accounts can describe distinct institutions and dated changes.
doesNotKnow: Inca civil-war chronology and why 1530 precedes the Spanish conquest of Cusco

objective: Inca civil-war chronology and why 1530 precedes the Spanish conquest of Cusco

claims.text: Cieza’s translated accession account separates Huascar’s royal ceremony from Cusco’s delegated city government. The Met and Cieza place Huayna Capac’s household at Quito and describe retrieval after his death, dated approximately. These are different royal and local relations before 1530. The accessible excerpt and uncollated originals do not establish universal allegiance, a precise civil-war chronology or later Spanish captivity.

recall.question: Why does accession not identify city government at both sites?

A royal accession identifies every city’s local government.
